resources.string: Configure your connection and audio, then allow the missing permissions. TiPlay checks the current Android grants and helps you open system settings when needed. Set up while parked.

Choose a connection mode, select your paired iPhone for wireless, and enter the hotspot or Wi-Fi details below. Pair in Android Bluetooth settings if needed. TiPlay waits for the car browser before connecting the iPhone.
Keep CarPlay audio enabled for browser music, calls and Siri through Android. Disable it to use the iPhone’s car Bluetooth route. Choose whether TiPlay should open at boot.

Allow missing permissions below. Each row shows the current system state; return here after changing system settings to check it again. Microphone is needed for TiPlay calls/Siri. USB device approval is requested when connecting a cable. After setup, open the pairing link in the car browser.
Runtime permissions are granted. Check the system settings below.
Some permissions or system settings are still unavailable. Related features may not work. Continue to Main settings, or return to complete setup.
